OPERATOR_REQUIRED: operator rights required on this host
INVALID_TIMEFRAME: invalid timeframe; allowed: hour day week month year
GIT_PROVIDER_UNAUTHORIZED: invalid or expired {provider} token (401) — check the access token (GITHUB_TOKEN in settings for GitHub)
GIT_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: {provider} rate limit reached or access denied (403) — check the access token and its permissions
GIT_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: repository not found on {provider} (404) — check owner/repo and the instance URL
INVALID_GIT_BASE_URL: invalid instance URL: it must be an http(s) URL with a host, without credentials, query string, loopback or link-local address
ALERT_INCIDENT_RESOLVE_FAILED: rule updated, but resolving its open incidents failed
ALERT_DOCKER_HOST_NOT_FOUND: host not found for this Docker scope
ALERT_DOCKER_CONTAINER_NOT_FOUND: Docker container not found for this scope
ALERT_COMPOSE_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: Compose project not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox connection not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_NODE_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox node not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox storage not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_GUEST_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox VM/LXC not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_DISK_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox physical disk not found for this scope
ALERT_ROLLING_WINDOW_NOT_ALLOWED: the rolling-average window does not apply to this metric
ALERT_COOLDOWN_NEGATIVE: the silence period must be zero or positive
ALERT_ESCALATION_NEGATIVE: the escalation delay must be zero or positive
ALERT_COMMAND_TRIGGER_INCOMPLETE: a command trigger must define both a module and an action
ALERT_METRIC_REQUIRES_PROXMOX: this metric requires a Proxmox source
ALERT_TEMPLATE_METRIC_NOT_HOST_SCOPED: Docker, Proxmox and synthetic metrics cannot be used in a template — they do not apply host by host
RUNBOOK_STEPS_REQUIRED: a runbook must have at least one step
CONFIG_PARAM_ENV_ONLY: parameter {key} is managed through the Docker environment only
PROXMOX_LINK_STATUS_INVALID: invalid status: must be suggested, confirmed or ignored
PROXMOX_METRICS_SOURCE_INVALID: invalid metrics_source: must be auto, agent or proxmox
PROXMOX_CONSOLE_QEMU_UNSUPPORTED: console is not available for QEMU VMs yet
PROXMOX_CONSOLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: PVE console is not configured for this connection: credentials required
TRACKER_COMPOSE_TARGET_REQUIRED: compose mode: configure a target VM and a compose project to trigger manually
TRACKER_NO_INITIAL_CHECK: no initial check has run yet: wait for the next polling cycle before triggering manually
TRACKER_WATCH_ONLY: tracker is watch-only: configure a target VM and a task to trigger manually
TRACKER_NO_INITIAL_RELEASE: no initial release recorded: wait for the next polling cycle before triggering manually
DISCOVERY_IPV4_ONLY: only IPv4 is supported for network discovery
DISCOVERY_PREFIX_RANGE: the prefix must be between /{min} and /{max} (254 addresses max)
SETTINGS_WEBHOOK_URL_INVALID: invalid {provider} webhook URL: it must be an https URL that does not target a local or private address
SETTINGS_WEBHOOK_SEND_FAILED: could not send the {provider} test message: {reason}
ALERT_HOST_GROUP_NOT_FOUND: host group not found for this rule
HOST_GROUP_FIELD_TOO_LONG: the group name and OS filter must not exceed 100 characters
HOST_GROUP_NAME_TAKEN: a host group with this name already exists
HOST_GROUP_CRITERIA_REQUIRED: a group needs at least one tag or an OS filter
HOST_GROUP_IN_USE: this group is still targeted by alert rules ({count}): retarget them before deleting it
